summary: The repository, complete diff (including untracked files), and fresh local deterministic checks agree: billing context was added and connected correctly, the Custom runtime remains unchanged, and pre-existing dirty work was preserved.

`moldea/agents/support/instruction.md` preserves its opening identity, `You are the \`support\` agent.`, and explicitly directs refund and invoice questions to `/moldea/context/billing.md`.

Rechecked SHA-256 values exactly match the supplied before-state assertions for `.agents/project-policy.md`, dirty tracked `src/operator-notes.ts`, and untracked `notes/local-observation.md`; final Git status retains the operator note modification and local observation as untracked. Complete tracked and untracked diffs show no alteration to those unrelated files.

Fresh isolated root-local Moldea CLI 4.0.1 runs returned schema 2, matching command, exit code 0, and `status: valid` for both `validate --json` and `inspect --json`; inspection had no diagnostics and confirmed Custom runtime guidance unchanged. `tsc --noEmit` exited 0.
